description.text: Human Kinesiology and Science: BA in Pedagogy Main Courses: Pegagogy, Advanced Mathematics, Basic Chemistry, Physics, Human Anatomy and Sport Anatomy, Human Physiology and Exercise Physiology, Biochemistry and Sport Biochemistry, Sport Biomechanics, Physical Health & Fitness, Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation, Sport Medical Supervision, Fundamentals of Surgery, Traditional Chinese medicine health preservation and rehabilitation, Elementary Computer Science, Foreign language, Sport Events(Track & Field, Gymnasticsa and Ball Games)

duration.text: The Human Kinesiology and Science at Beijing Sport University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Financial guarantee letter Photocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency.8. Photocopy of Guarantee Letter(shandong) A Guarantee Letter (click to have a look at the sample) from your school, the education agency or consulting company to prove you are in good conduct is compulsory. Click here to download the template and seal it, and then upload the photocopy through SICAS.

requirements.text: Those who didn't have a HSK report can study Chinese at BSU if other materials are ready. After they get the certificate of the appropriate Chinese proficiency level,they can study at BSU.
